params.name: name
params.description: Form field name, also used to build checkbox ids.

name: selected
description: Currently applied filters, rendered as links that remove them. Omit entirely when nothing is selected.

name: clearHref
description: URL that clears every filter. Omitted if not set.

name: id
description: Prefix for the content id used by the disclosure button.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the filter.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the filter.
